newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-PSP UPS FISKARS TO BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-PSP UPS FISKARS TO BUY.

text.p: Finnish Postipankki on Monday upgraded Finnish durable consumer goods grop Fiskars shares to long term buy from hold, after the group reported better-than-expected H1 earnings, analyst Teemu Lahkela said.
"The upgrade is based on its acquisitions and the fact that Fiskars has done well in the U.S. -- the growth outlook of private consumption in the U.S. is strong," Lahkela said.

Fiskars earlier reported profit after financial items rising to 219 million markka in January-June from 139 million, beating the highest forecast by 15 million markka. Earnings per share totalled 20.00 markka, up from 11.40 markka.
Postipankki upped its 1997 EPS estimate to 36.00 markka from 25.00, Lahkela said, adding that his 1998 EPS forecast would be "near 40.00 markka".
Lahkela also said that Fiskars' 51 percent equity-to-assets would enable Fiskars to stay acquisitive.
